Hi team (and Sara),

Putting the first draft of the briefing pack and travel ops spreadsheet into the shared Drive — attaching v0.3 and travel lanes v2.1 here for quick review. We have three priorities in the next 72 hours:

2) Lock speaker handoffs and pre-read assignments — Marissa, please confirm who on our side will own the two 20-minute breakout demos.
3) Confirm travel lanes and arrival times so Ops can prep room setup and badges — Neha, can you validate the travel spreadsheet against the travel desk?

Attachments referenced: Exec_Briefing_Pack_v0.3.pptx (deck), Travel_Lanes_2.1.xlsx (arrival times + hotel shuttles), Speaker_Handoffs_v1.pdf (role matrix).

Action items in this thread: please reply with owner confirmations and any redlines by EOD Monday PST.

Thanks,
